userStories.title: One LLM call selects headline + up to two supporting moments
acceptanceCriteria: Cheap-tier model from primary_provider is used
Each candidate includes dim_key, quoted_excerpt, why_it_lost_score, suggested_alternative, severity, session_started_at, dollar_impact_estimate, recurrence_count over previous 3 weeks
Response is JSON with headline_moment_id, headline_reason (one sentence), and supporting_moment_ids (up to 2)
Supporting moments prefer different dims from the headline
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Validate selected IDs against candidate set; re-prompt once on failure
acceptanceCriteria: headline_moment_id and every supporting_moment_id must exist in the input candidate set
If validation fails the model is re-prompted once with the specific error
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fallback to most-recent major-then-moderate moment on protocol failure
acceptanceCriteria: If the second selector attempt is still invalid, headline becomes the most-recent moment with severity='major'
If no major-severity moment exists, headline becomes the most-recent moderate moment
Supporting moments list is left empty in the fallback path
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Skip selector entirely when only one candidate exists; hard cap of 3 moments
acceptanceCriteria: If exactly one candidate moment exists for the week, no LLM call is made and that moment is the headline
Even if the LLM returns more than two supporting IDs, only the first two are kept
Total moments rendered in the digest never exceeds 3
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
